Obligations of Access Providers, National Long Distance Operators and International Long Distance Operators.— (1) All existing interconnect agreements or arrangements between Access Providers, National Long Distance Operators and International Long Distance Operators shall, upon the coming into force of these regulations, stand amended so as to conform to the provisions of these regulations as regards routing of calls to and from ported mobile numbers.
